methods.label: Freeze and magic kill
methods.summary: Freeze Scorpia and kill it with magic while controlling Wilderness risk.
prayers: Protect from Missiles or Magic as needed
steps: Use magic because Scorpia has very low magic defence.
Freeze Scorpia to reduce incoming melee pressure and keep distance.
Attack with Wilderness sceptres or trident-class weapons.
Stay alert for player-killers and leave before being pinned.
risks: A failed freeze can force extra food use.

methods.label: Healer control and risk
methods.summary: Respond to Scorpia guardian healing and keep trips short enough to protect loot.
steps: Watch for Scorpia guardians and prevent them from undoing too much damage.
Re-freeze or reposition when adds disrupt the fight.
Bank valuable drops instead of extending in deep Wilderness.
